messages.subject: Scaling
parts:
I'm doing some scaling/linking/equating. I fit a Graded Response Model to one set of data and I'd like to use the estimates from this run as fixed parameters in a Graded Response Model fit to a new set of data. So, I would need to modify the data.frame from pars = 'values'. Is there a straightforward way to modify this data.frame and input results from coef()?

Kevin

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Scaling
parts: The quickest way to do this is to use the mod2values() function to convert an estimated model into the suitable data.frame, and set all the $est values to FALSE (see ?mod2values). This should be okay provided that the groups have the same category number and structure, i.e., if item 1 has 4 categories endorsed in group 1, then it has to have 4 categories endorsed in group 2 (they can't all be just 4's or something like that). If this is a problem then multipleGroup can deal with this directly, but it's a bit harder to set up with this method. Hope that helps!
